items.title: Rick Montalbano interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 12, 2011
items.q: Probably the worst gig in my recent history was a Christmas party that Tony Cee booked me for.

ctx.x: What about your worst gig ever?

Probably the worst gig in my recent history was a Christmas party that Tony Cee booked me for. It was a solo piano gig at the Radisson or at the Sheraton in Utica, an office Christmas party. And they had a piano, a little upright piano or something there. And I was very thorough when he was calling me for the gig, “are you sure they want just piano music? They’re not looking for a band? They’re not looking for a singer?” “No, no, no, they just want some Christmas tunes, nice background music, and that’s it.”…
“Blue Christmas.” And you look at your watch and it’s going backwards. This gig will never end.
